name: painted-place
description: Build a place in Blender and bring it into the series' painted blue-hour look in one call, with the old-and-used details made from the place's own shape and from what the camera sees: laid setts and flags, flat stone walls built up into ashlar with dressed windows, casings, sills and sashes for windows in plaster and timber walls, old brass, copper and glazed china, real stone grain and photographed timber, bark and sand (free Poly Haven scans), lapped boards, puddles where lights mirror, gutter water, damp, rot, stains, rust, weeds, moss and rubbish, water's edges (wet sand, foam, a tide line, driftwood, mossy banks) and what trees drop; then a blind judge says in plain words whether it has the look and shows what was asked for, and what to fix, once.
